arrayEncoding: Complex vectors interleave real and imaginary amplitudes.
scientificAssumptions: Circuit-level model. Hypothetical architectures. No physical validation, manufacturing, throughput, energy or cost claim.
Noiseless ideal reference uses the same seeded phase settings, inputs and targets. Readout noise is a reproducible complex field perturbation.
Frobenius estimates use exact basis vectors up to 16×16, then seeded Rademacher probes. Compensation fits one nonnegative real gain.
Block processors use exact electronic R pre-processing, optical Q and electronic accumulation. Payload estimates exclude protocol overhead.
